summary: Autopay on the one-time payment path (PR #411): new nullable columns on assessment_autopay (card funding, setup session, the accepted terms and version, the fee and total named in the 10-day notice) and assessment_autopay_runs.payment_group_id with an index; the run outcome list gains skipped_paused, skipped_not_payable, skipped_fee_changed and skipped_in_flight. Additive only. No enrollments exist; no payments or ledger rows change. Charging stays off until AUTOPAY_CHARGES_ENABLED is set.

preflight.name: assessment_autopay exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'assessment_autopay'

preflight.name: new columns do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'assessment_autopay' AND column_name IN ('card_funding','setup_session_id','authorized_terms','authorized_terms_version','noticed_fee_cents','noticed_total_cents')

expected_changes: assessment_autopay: new nullable columns card_funding, setup_session_id, authorized_terms, authorized_terms_version, noticed_fee_cents, noticed_total_cents, with their CHECKs.
assessment_autopay_runs: new nullable column payment_group_id and partial index assessment_autopay_runs_group_idx; outcome CHECK widened with four new skip outcomes.
Column comments added. No rows added, changed or deleted.

verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'assessment_autopay' AND column_name IN ('card_funding','setup_session_id','authorized_terms','authorized_terms_version','noticed_fee_cents','noticed_total_cents')
